title: III-IV: metonymic and ironic attributes
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): 1 Corinthians 1:21,25. Jeremiah 4:10; Psalms; Job 38:3 plus 40:2; 1 Kings 22:15; To this stand as referred Genesis 3:22; Ironic attributes stand as those that same which stand as enunciated belonging toward God by means belonging toward irony. IV. Jeremiah 14:8. our hope — 1 Timothy 1:1; Jeremiah 17:17; trust — Psalm 65; And in ye same sense our glory — Psalm 3:4; Thus He stands as called our song — Exodus 15:2 — because He stands as ye subject belonging toward that same which we sing. strength, salvation, plus help — our salvation plus help — Psalm 27:1,9 — because He stands as ye author plus giver belonging toward our firmness. strength — Psalm 22:20; Thus God stands as called firmness — Psalm 18:2; Metonymic attributes stand as those that same which stand as said belonging toward God by means belonging toward metonymy. III.
pass_b_english: III. Metonymic attributes are those which are said of God by metonymy. Thus God is called firmness — Psalm 18:2; strength — Psalm 22:20; our salvation and help — Psalm 27:1,9 — because He is the author and giver of our firmness, strength, salvation, and help. Thus He is called our song — Exodus 15:2 — because He is the subject of which we sing. And in the same sense our glory — Psalm 3:4; trust — Psalm 65; Jeremiah 17:17; our hope — 1 Timothy 1:1; Jeremiah 14:8.
IV. Ironic attributes are those which are enunciated of God by irony. To this are referred Genesis 3:22; 1 Kings 22:15; Job 38:3 and 40:2; Psalms; Jeremiah 4:10; 1 Corinthians 1:21,25.
source_text: III. Metonymica attributa sunt, quae de Deo per metonymiam dicuntur. Sic Deus dicitur firmitas — Psal. XVIII.2; fortitudo — Psal. XXII.20; salus et auxilium nostrum — Psal. XXVII.1,9 — quia est firmitatis, fortitudinis, salutis, auxiliique nostri auctor et dator. Sic dicitur carmen nostrum — Exod. XV.2 — quia est subjectum de quo canimus. Eodemque sensu gloria nostra — Psal. III.4; fiducia — Psal. LXV; Jerem. XVII.17; spes nostra — I Tim. I.1; Jer. XIV.8. IV. Ironica attributa sunt, quae per ironiam de Deo enunciantur. Huc referuntur Gen. III.22; I Reg. XXII.15; Job. XXXVIII.3 et XL.2; Psal.; Jer. IV.10; I Cor. I.21,25.
